title: Building the Distributions
description: One command builds the package into two files in dist/: a source distribution and a wheel.

steps.description: This builds the package. The page says it creates two distribution files in `dist/`.
The comments name the two files: `dist/mylang_cs374-0.1.0.tar.gz`, the source distribution, and `dist/mylang_cs374-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl`, the wheel.
